<div class="card-body">
'''Lt. Pol Treidum''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ポル・トライダム中尉</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「ドッキング・コントロール・ルーム327」にいる場合、「ドッキング・ベイ327」における自分の戦闘力の合計に２を加える。自分の各支配フェイズに１回だけ、もし潜伏中のスパイと同じ位置にいるなら、運命数を引ける。運命数＝スパイの能力値なら、スパイは“正体を現す”。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Lt-Pol-Treidum-SWCA-100660.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ドッキング・ベイ内の管制ガントリーに配属された士官。磁気フィールドの開閉、空気の安定供給、保安体制の維持などを担当する。ラルティアの作戦以来、反乱軍スパイの侵入に対して神経質になった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Lt. Pol Treidum.

'''Card text:'''
While at Docking Control Room 327, add 2 to your total power at Docking Bay 327. Once during each of your control phases, if at the same location as an undercover spy, you may draw destiny. If destiny equals the spy’s ability, the spy’s cover is broken.

'''Lore:'''
An officer assigned to the docking bay control gantry. He handles opening and closing the magnetic field, a stable air supply, and security. Since the Ralltiir mission, he has grown nervous about Rebel spy infiltration.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore names gantry duties (magnetic field, air supply, security) and ラルティア.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lt. Pol Treidum]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
